lesson: SIM FACTS FIRST (verified, scratchpad/end/lifecheck.py): a fruit rots exactly 50 s after it spawns (grow(2*dt) advances age 2/s, removed above 100) so lin_map's fr_ttl=80 is 30 s too long; standing costs 1 energy/s (0.1 per STEP), walking 0.05 per requested px = 6 energy/s at 10 px/step; a tree's death test runs EVERY step with hazard ((age-50)/50)^2, so trees die at mean age 57.9 (p05 53.4, p95 62.5), never 100 - productive life (from age 20) is ~37 s, and a tree IN VIEW is alive by definition. One camped tree = 0.1 fruit/s = 2 energy/s harvested on sight vs 6 energy/s harvested ripe. RESULT: harvest discipline does what the economics predict (predator deaths -6%, starvation -4%, old-age deaths +4%, games >= 1500 25%->38%) but it buys the top half and sells the bottom half (p25 -83), so the mean is flat. MAP-DRIVEN RELOCATION IS CLOSED: even the disciplined version (only when no tree is in view, claimed sites, arrival-time valuation) costs -40 and +31% starvation - the fourth independent failure of that idea in this lane (surv3-map arm A, surv2-disperse BARREN EXIT and LATE DISPERSION). Frozen scorer, Mac, seeds 9000-9063, 4-seed single-proc chunks, paired vs a lin_map draw of the same seeds under the same load
lesson: THE ANGLE IS DEAD, and the better the wall memory the worse the score: lin_tail F3 (per-agent, 60 s, acted on 3% of close-predator steps) was -31.5 se 39.8; end_pred (shared, exact, permanent, acted on 28% of corridor calls) is -126.3 se 37.6. Being pinned against a wall is where kills are OBSERVED, not what causes them. bb_juke' juke is 1.25 rad off away TOWARD THE SIDE THE CHASER' HEADING ERRS TO (beats the 0.3 rad/step turn cap) and the back-pedal holds the 10.6 px/step pivot closing to ~0 while draining the predator 2.55/step; both point at "away", so any wall-aware correction gives that mechanism back - and update_entity_position ALREADY slides a blocked agent along the wall at the full requested distance, for free. Predator deaths +32% is the mechanism, not noise. Do not re-try wall-aware evasion; third confirmation that close-range evasion is a dead island (bb_mpc it3, evolve A g5, this). The wall map code itself (_add_seg/_local_walls/_near_segs in end_pred.py) is exact and ~1 ms/step - reuse it for FOOD routing around obstacles, not for fleeing. end_pred.py now defaults ep_on=0 = byte-identical to lin_map (verified).
